beta.notes:
Fixes:
• Folder scans now recognize current PCA filename shorthand such as Alg and Eng, glued grade levels, part numbers, and common student-name separators so matching work reaches the correct roster course.
• Scanned files that match no course are now offered for placement instead of being quietly dropped, and the original scanned files are never deleted.
• Crash and debug reports now retain attached screenshots and the full redacted native crash dump from the crashed session, without resending that dump on a later launch.
• Attaching a clipboard screenshot to a debug report no longer fails with an error.
• Fixed Schoology re-downloads failing after a live thread revision because the refreshed submission data was held in the wrong in-memory format.
• Samples imported without a work date now fall inside their learning period instead of defaulting to today.
• Pathways uploads now accept any saved Work Date format rather than rejecting some of them.
• The toolbar learning period button now shows the current learning period as soon as the app opens.
• Four import and scan steps that could fail silently now report the problem instead of losing a sample without a word.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
